purpose: Teach: ハワイアン/ノーマル/ヤンキー/ハーモニー/ユニオン/ベール/ダイジェスト/レベルアップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがハワイアンギターを練習された
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he used to practice Hawaiian guitar.
lines.style: Soft, remembering gaze into the distance. Gentle opening. Steady, unhurried pace. The voice of someone holding onto a small, warm memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ノーマルな生活を大事にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you always valued living a simple, ordinary life, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, affectionate half-smile in the voice. A small, knowing lift at the end — not quite a question, more a gentle reminder. Tender without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの友人にヤンキー風の方がいらした
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he had a friend with that wild, reckless look about him.
lines.style: Same soft distance as before. Slight curiosity underneath — wondering where this memory leads. Quiet, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、合唱団のハーモニーを愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you — you loved the harmony of a good choir, didn't you? That always meant so much to you.
lines.style: Gentle affection in her voice. A small knowing nod embedded in the words. Tender and present, speaking to something real she remembers about him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがソビエト連邦解体とユニオン崩壊を語られた
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he used to talk about the fall of the Soviet Union and the collapse of everything we thought was solid.
lines.style: The same nostalgic distance, but with a slight weightiness underneath. The memory carries more than just wistfulness — a hint of the gravity of those times. Still soft, but with depth.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、私のウエディングベールを大事にして下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you — you treasured my wedding veil, didn't you? You were so careful with it, so proud.
lines.style: Warmth with a slight catch underneath — memory of beauty and care. A soft brightness in the voice, like she's seeing him in that moment again. Tender, present, almost intimate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが歴史ドラマのダイジェストを観られた
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he'd watch those historical drama digests, just trying to understand the world.
lines.style: The nostalgic distance returns, but gentler now — almost like a lullaby. Steady, patient. The voice of someone at peace with simple memories.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご自身のキャリアのレベルアップを目指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you — you kept pushing yourself to grow, to reach higher in your career, didn't you? Always striving, always believing in yourself.
lines.style: Soft warmth with underlying admiration. A gentle, steady cadence. The voice of someone seeing his effort and honoring it. Tender closing — trailing off with affection and respect.
